newsitem.title: USA: LG&E to supply power to Oglethorpe Power.
newsitem.headline: LG&E to supply power to Oglethorpe Power.

text.p: LG&E Energy Corp said Tuesday that its power marketing unit has been awarded a contract worth between $4.5 billion to $5 billion to supply power to Oglethorpe Power Corp.
Under the deal, LG&E will supply more than 200 million megawatt hours of electricity to Oglethorpe on a "long-term basis."
The contract is to take effect on January 1, 1997, the companies said. The estimated price tag is based on current market prices.
Oglethorpe, which is based in Atlanta, provides wholesale electricity to 39 of Georgia's 42 customer-owned electric membership corporations.
LG&E is based in Fairfax, Va.
